## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `security` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `pm:queue` · land after PR #23592 · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T03:56Z

Read fresh. Function level only. The approvals inbox resolves each row's subject `record_title` under the system context, unnarrowed by the reading approver. An approver whose readable fields exclude the subject's display field gets a redacted payload and an unredacted title, on both the single and the list read. This was measured in-process by #23556's dev. It breaks `payload-redaction.ts`'s serve-time contract (#10749) and #7497's ruling C.
- **`priority:p2` + `security`:** a measured field-level disclosure. What leaks is the subject's display value, to an approver routed to that very record. It is not another principal's row and not a record outside the approver's routing, so it is not p1.
- **Not in the protocol-first class:** the answer withholds what the caller may not read, and nothing is refused.
- **Lane `domain:services`** (`plugin-approvals`). It lands **after PR #23592**, which puts the inbox, the toasts and the action-link pages behind one function (`resolveSubjectDisplays`). The fix sits there, once.
- **Scope:** the card's "done" lines and pins.
  - The approval notification naming the record by its title (#23556's remaining half) waits on this card. It is stored and may be emailed.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"). A security narrowing of a served field. One contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue, run by an isolated subagent.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `plugin-approvals' resolveSubjectDisplays (this lane) reads the subject title under SYSTEM_CTX and enrichRows serves it unnarrowed | payload-redaction.ts already narrows the payload snapshot per reader through FieldVisibilitySource (#10749), and #7497 ruling C keeps record access with object permissions and FLS | every routed approver reading the inbox, the request detail, a decision toast or an action-link page (measured in-process by #23556's dev)`
Thread-read: 6184043475
Serial constraints cleared: PR #23592 (#23556) has landed as `a6d0715535`, triage's stated order. No open PR touches `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/**` (every open PR's file list read at this write). #23556's remaining half (`nameSubjectRecord` naming the title) is `Blocked-by: #23594` and is not in flight.
